dslRule:
<!id: string.trim.length.zero.to.isempty>
<!description: Replace String.trim().length() == 0 with String.trim().isEmpty().>
<!severity: HINT>

$x.trim().length() == 0
=>
$x.trim().isEmpty()
;;
summary: Replaces `String.trim().length() == 0` with `String.trim().isEmpty()` for conciseness and readability, leveraging the `isEmpty()` method introduced in Java 6.
